mapper.sql: id, period_code, contract_code, client_code, business_code, org_id, bill_contract_code, currency_code, account_code, account_name, year_begin_debit_balance, year_begin_credit_balance, month_begin_debit_balance, month_begin_credit_balance, month_debit_amount, month_credit_amount, year_debit_amount, year_credit_amount, month_end_debit_balance, month_end_credit_balance, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag
mapper.select: with ev_eve as ( select ev.contract_code ,ev.org_id ,eve.account_code, eve.bill_contract_code,ev.currency,eve.client_code ,eve.account_name, sum(eve.debit_amount) debit_amount, sum(eve.credit_amount) credit_amount from eg_voucher ev join eg_voucher_entry eve on ev.id = eve.voucher_id where 1=1 and ev.period_code = #{periodCode} and eve.period_code = #{periodCode} group by ev.contract_code ,ev.org_id ,eve.account_code ,eve.bill_contract_code,ev.currency,eve.client_code ,eve.account_name ) ,em_emv as ( select emv.contract_code ,em.org_id ,emv.account_code, emv.loans_contract_code bill_contract_code,em.currency_code,emv.client_code ,emv.account_name ,sum(emv.debit_amount) debit_amount,sum(emv.credit_amount) credit_amount from eg_manual em join eg_manual_voucher emv on em.id = emv.manual_id where 1=1 and em.period_code = #{periodCode} and emv.period_code = #{periodCode} and em.process_status = '1' group by emv.contract_code ,em.org_id ,emv.account_code ,emv.loans_contract_code,em.currency_code,emv.client_code ,emv.account_name ) insert into eg_account_assist_balance_temp_close_period(id,period_code ,contract_code,client_code,business_code ,org_id ,bill_contract_code,currency_code,account_code,account_name, year_begin_debit_balance ,year_begin_credit_balance ,month_begin_debit_balance, month_begin_credit_balance,month_debit_amount,month_credit_amount,year_debit_amount,year_credit_amount,month_end_debit_balance,month_end_credit_balance) select nextval('account_assist_close_period_seq'), ${periodCode} period_code, coalesce(eaab.contract_code,ev_eve.contract_code,em_emv.contract_code,null) contract_code , coalesce(eaab.client_code,ev_eve.client_code,em_emv.client_code,null) client_code, eaab.business_code, coalesce(eaab.org_id,ev_eve.org_id,em_emv.org_id,'') org_id, coalesce(eaab.bill_contract_code,ev_eve.bill_contract_code,em_emv.bill_contract_code,'') bill_contract_code, coalesce(eaab.currency_code,ev_eve.currency,em_emv.currency_code,'') currency_code, coalesce(eaab.account_code,ev_eve.account_code,em_emv.account_code,'') account_code, coalesce(eaab.account_name,ev_eve.account_name,em_emv.account_name,'') account_name, coalesce(case when substring(202405::text,5,2) != '01' then eaab.year_begin_debit_balance else eaab.month_end_debit_balance end,0) year_begin_debit_balance, coalesce(case when substring(202405::text,5,2) != '01' then eaab.year_begin_credit_balance else eaab.month_end_credit_balance end,0) year_begin_credit_balance, coalesce(eaab.month_end_debit_balance,0) month_begin_debit_balance, coalesce(eaab.month_end_credit_balance,0) month_begin_credit_balance, coalesce(ev_eve.debit_amount,0) + coalesce(em_emv.debit_amount,0) month_debit_amount, coalesce(ev_eve.credit_amount,0) + coalesce(em_emv.credit_amount,0) month_credit_amount, coalesce(eaab.year_debit_amount,0) + coalesce(ev_eve.debit_amount,0) + coalesce(em_emv.debit_amount,0) year_debit_amount, coalesce(eaab.year_credit_amount,0) + coalesce(ev_eve.credit_amount,0) + coalesce(em_emv.credit_amount,0) year_credit_amount, coalesce(eaab.month_end_debit_balance,0) + coalesce(ev_eve.debit_amount,0) + coalesce(em_emv.debit_amount,0) month_end_debit_balance, coalesce(eaab.month_end_credit_balance,0) + coalesce(ev_eve.credit_amount,0) + coalesce(em_emv.credit_amount,0) month_end_credit_balance from eg_account_assist_balance eaab full outer join ev_eve on coalesce(eaab.contract_code,'') = coalesce(ev_eve.contract_code ,'') and coalesce(eaab.client_code,'') = coalesce(ev_eve.client_code ,'') and coalesce(eaab.org_id,'') = coalesce(ev_eve.org_id,'') and coalesce(eaab.bill_contract_code,'') = coalesce(ev_eve.bill_contract_code ,'') and coalesce(eaab.currency_code,'') = coalesce(ev_eve.currency,'') and coalesce(eaab.account_code,'') = coalesce(ev_eve.account_code,'') full outer join em_emv on coalesce(eaab.contract_code,'') = coalesce(em_emv.contract_code ,'') and coalesce(eaab.client_code,'') = coalesce(em_emv.client_code ,'') and coalesce(eaab.org_id,'') = coalesce(em_emv.org_id,'') and coalesce(eaab.bill_contract_code,'') = coalesce(em_emv.bill_contract_code ,'') and coalesce(eaab.currency_code,'') = coalesce(em_emv.currency_code,'') and coalesce(eaab.account_code,'') = coalesce(em_emv.account_code,'') where eaab.period_code = #{prevPeriodCode}

insert into eg_account_assist_balance_temp_close_period(id,period_code ,contract_code,client_code,business_code ,org_id ,bill_contract_code,currency_code,account_code,account_name, year_begin_debit_balance ,year_begin_credit_balance ,month_begin_debit_balance, month_begin_credit_balance,month_debit_amount,month_credit_amount,year_debit_amount,year_credit_amount,month_end_debit_balance,month_end_credit_balance)
select nextval('account_assist_close_period_seq'), ${nextPeriodCode} period_code, eaab.contract_code, eaab.client_code, eaab.business_code, eaab.org_id, eaab.bill_contract_code, eaab.currency_code, eaab.account_code, eaab.account_name, case when substring(#{periodCode}::text,5,2) != '01' then eaab.year_begin_debit_balance else eaab.month_end_debit_balance end as year_begin_debit_balance, case when substring(#{periodCode}::text,5,2) != '01' then eaab.year_begin_credit_balance else eaab.month_end_credit_balance end as year_begin_credit_balance, eaab.month_end_debit_balance month_begin_debit_balance, eaab.month_end_credit_balance month_begin_credit_balance, 0 month_debit_amount, 0 month_credit_amount, 0 year_debit_amount, 0 year_credit_amount, eaab.month_end_debit_balance month_end_debit_balance, eaab.month_end_credit_balance month_end_credit_balance from eg_account_assist_balance eaab where eaab.period_code = #{periodCode}
select max(id)+1 as next_val from eg_account_assist_balance eaab
